battery.name: induction
battery.template_set: olsson-2022 §Data Collection (3) with departures: 25 distinct token ids uniform in [1000, 45000) as a frequency proxy (ours); 2 repeats, the second cut after x_i, i uniform in 1..22; competitor x_j, j uniform in i+3..25

corruption.name: fresh_prefix
corruption.removes: the earlier occurrence of x_i and its successor (what induction copies), and the in-context occurrence of both c and s
corruption.inserts: an equally long unrepeated random prefix: 25 fresh token ids under the same sampling rule, distinct from each other and from every clean token; length, positions, the second half and the sampling distribution kept. Expected corrupt ld near 0 by symmetry

effect_sign: positive = ablating the component hurt (clean minus intervened, on the clean prompt)
command: uv run python -m src.lesion.e3_sweep --item all --stage floor
